name: Social media – videos
steps: Open Online Store > Themes > Customize for an unpublished copy. Choose the page template, select Add section, and choose Social media – videos.
Select Add block inside this section. Use the supported block types listed below, then drag them into the desired reading order.
Connect your own content and media before adjusting layout, typography, color, and spacing. Section overrides take priority where the section offers them.
Preview desktop and mobile, test any links or controls, and save. Publish only after reviewing the complete customer journey.

settings.content: Merchant-curated content and native links unless an explicit provider embed is configured. The theme does not fetch social posts, authorize accounts, verify claims or implement feed synchronization. Future feed/playlist choices are retained configuration placeholders, not connected integrations.
